thread:
sophie (CS Lead): Hey team — BrightLeaf renewal is 4/08. They asked for a consolidated SLO mapping + evidence bundle to explain onboarding variance and why we shouldn’t apply latency/uptime credits. Can we pull this together by EOD Fri? @marcus @jonah
marcus (SRE): I can assemble service-level metrics and incident timeline. Will need the exact window they want (onboarding ramp dates).
priya (AE): They called out Mar 1–31 as their onboarding month. I'll confirm, but that's what they referenced in the renewal call.
jonah (Data): Got it. I can export p50/p95/p99, request volume, and KV-cache hit rates. Will include compute anomalies.
liza (CSM): I'll draft the customer narrative and include the enablement sessions schedule. They care about how much traffic we routed to Dedicated vs. Hosted.
sophie (CS Lead): Perfect. Targets we need to show: uptime (%), latency p95/p99, incident list with MTTR, and the formula that maps missing SLO to credit amount. Also include the rollout notes (model pinning/rollbacks) used during the period.
marcus (SRE): Quick heads-up — there was one infra incident on Mar 12 affecting one AZ for ~18m; automatic fallback to other region kept most traffic healthy. I'll include tracer snapshots and the circuit-breaker logs.
jonah (Data): I'll attach these artifacts (CSV + image snapshots). Example extract: ```
period,uptime,p95_ms,p99_ms,requests
2024-03-01_to_2024-03-31,99.953,120,380,1_245_678
```
jonah (Data): Also generating a bleed-down chart for latency vs. traffic to show correlation with onboarding spike.
marcus (SRE): Links to traces/dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/brightleaf/slo?view=mar2024 and retention snapshot https://s3.redwood.ai/brightleaf/mar2024/evidence.zip
priya (AE): For the credit calc, note their contract defines uptime SLO at 99.9% monthly, latency p95 target 150ms. We missed p95 once during the incident window but overall monthly p95 is below threshold. I'll include the contract clause in the packet.
liza (CSM): Draft customer note for review: "We tracked the onboarding period Mar 1–31 and observed a single regional degradation on Mar 12. We applied our fallback policies; overall uptime for the month remained within contractual band. Here are the artifacts and the credit calculation showing no credit due."
sophie (CS Lead): Nice. Two asks before I sign off on the packet: (1) Jonah — add a short paragraph explaining sampling method for p99 (full sample vs. tail-sampling). (2) Marcus — export the tracer IDs and a short sequence of the rollout notes (timestamps + who executed rollback).
jonah (Data): Will do. Adding sampling note: we used end-to-end request latencies at edge, deduplicated retries, and computed p99 on full sample.
marcus (SRE): Rollout notes export path: /ops/playbooks/brightleaf/rollouts/2024-03.json — I'll pull an excerpt.
uptime-bot: Incident #20240312 created by monitors; severity: P2; duration: 18m; auto-notified on-call.
sophie (CS Lead): Great. Can we meet Thu 10:30 PT for a 20-min packet review before I send Friday? @priYa (AE) pls confirm.
priya (AE): Confirmed. I'll be there. :thumbsup:
liza (CSM): I'll bring the customer-facing slides and the enablement attendance logs.
jonah (Data): Packet draft ETA: Thu 8:00 PT for initial artifacts, final by Thu 11:30 PT.
marcus (SRE): I'll drop tracer excerpts and rollback timeline by Thu 9:30 PT.
sophie (CS Lead): Thanks all — if anyone hits blockers ping me directly. I'll own the cover note and final send. :pray:
